videos.title: Lam：原子尺度工程時代
watchFor: 沉積增加材料、蝕刻選擇性移除材料，兩者需要搭配。
原子層操作著重循環控制；不可把每一循環必定等於完整原子層。
高深寬比及三維結構使均勻性與選擇性同時重要。
watchForEn: Deposition adds material while etching removes selected material; the processes work together.
Atomic-layer methods use controlled cycles; do not assume every cycle necessarily equals one complete atomic layer.
High-aspect-ratio and 3D features make both uniformity and selectivity important.

videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Draw three-sided gate control requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「三維介電覆蓋」列為查證任務：檢查結果是否能支持「頂部膜厚合格不代表側壁合格。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Assess 3D dielectric coverage: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptable top thickness does not prove sidewall coverage. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

related.transfer: 從平面到 FinFET 再到 GAA，閘控制面數、有效寬度與加工可達性一起改變。
related.transferEn: From planar to FinFET to GAA, gate coverage, effective width and process access change together.
related.difference: 本課驗收重點是鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動；「平面 CMOS 製程整合」則以井區、接面及互補電路連通為另一個工作包。共用原理不代表可照搬尺寸、材料或接受門檻。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive; Planar CMOS process integration treats wells, junctions and complementary-circuit connectivity as a different work package. Shared principles do not justify copying dimensions, materials or acceptance limits.
practice: 畫出鰭式電晶體製造與平面 CMOS 製程整合之間的材料或資料交接
用「三面閘控制」作為兩課比較起點，列出一項相同與一項不同邊界
選一項鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動的觀察，說明還需哪個平面 CMOS 製程整合證據才可放行
practiceEn: Draw the material or data handoff between FinFET fabrication and Planar CMOS process integration
Use draw three-sided gate control to identify one shared and one different boundary
Choose an observation from fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive and state which additional Planar CMOS process integration evidence is needed for acceptance
related.title: 平面 CMOS 製程整合

related.difference: 本課驗收重點是鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動；「環繞閘極奈米片電晶體」則以片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異為另一個工作包。共用原理不代表可照搬尺寸、材料或接受門檻。

Shared principles do not justify copying dimensions, materials or acceptance limits.

practiceEn: Draw the material or data handoff between FinFET fabrication and Gate-all-around nanosheet transistors
Use track fin pattern transfer to identify one shared and one different boundary
Choose an observation from fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive and state which additional Gate-all-around nanosheet transistors evidence is needed for acceptance
